lines.zh: 我踩着拍子走，一步一响。
lines.en: I walk on the beat, one step one note.

lines.zh: 我的脚步合着一段曲子。
lines.en: My steps keep time with a tune.
I come walking from the far end of the hall.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边哼那段调子。
lines.en: I hum that phrase as I walk.
I am not fast, but I never stop.
My stride drags and the sound runs long.
I walk around a patch of blackness.
I go toward the sound.
My shadow sways in time.
I pause outside the door.

lines.zh: 脚步没有声音，只有画面在抖。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; only the image shakes.
I step out from the corner of the wall.

lines.zh: 我的头偏到不该有的角度。
lines.en: My head tilts to an angle it shouldn't.

lines.zh: 那段调子在我脑子里转。
lines.en: That phrase turns in my head.

lines.zh: 空气里有节奏，只有我听得见。
lines.en: There is a rhythm in the air only I can hear.
I stand under the lamp; my shadow stays still.
Half my face is in the dark.
I am waiting for the next bar.
My breathing keeps the beat.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子不动，我在动。
lines.en: The shadow on the wall is still. I am not.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把手举起来，又放下。
lines.en: Slowly I raise a hand and let it fall.

lines.zh: 有人在很远的地方唱歌。
lines.en: Someone is singing far away.
I listen, and I smile.
The song ends, and I begin.
I raise my eyes and look ahead.

lines.zh: 影子投在墙上，长得不像我。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is taller than me.
When I open my mouth, only current hisses.
We have not started yet.
You are standing in the wrong place.
I do not blink. Do not wait for it.
There is no sound behind you now.
This part was left for you.
Your hands are shaking. I hear it.
When I smile, do not smile back.
You have been looking a long time.
It is dark here. I can see clearly.
Will you sing along?
I have been waiting for you to turn.
This face of mine was painted on.
The floor knocked. That was not me.
Count to three and I move.
This one will run long.

lines.zh: 我的手指在屏幕外伸向你。
lines.en: My fingers reach for you from beyond the screen.
Back away. It will do you no good.
Sing. Do not stop.
I know this opening.
My movement lost a beat.
I give half a step and straighten.
The beat has not stopped; neither will I.
Blood on the dark floor.
I tilt my head at you, saying nothing.
I am still listening to that phrase.
My face splits; the grin stays.
The wound scatters like noise.
I have your measure now.
The rhythm has not stopped.
That is off the beat.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，在我眼里是噪点。
lines.en: What you hold is only noise to me.
That noise has interrupted me.
I do not eat. I listen.
That would crack loudly.
Put it down and I will continue.
That sound is not enough.
I tilted my head and listened.
No. That is not the phrase.
Take it away. Too loud.
You hit me and I lost one beat.
You bump me; my grin doesn't change.
Get out of this square.

lines.zh: 我的影子黏住了你的鞋底。
lines.en: My shadow sticks to your sole.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我的眼睛是黑的。
lines.en: When you look, my eyes are black.
The rhythm did not break.
I step half a block aside.

lines.zh: 你又撞了一下，还是没动我。
lines.en: Another hit, and I still have not moved.
That knocked you back.
One touch and your fingertips go numb.

lines.zh: 这一段只有我一个人唱。
lines.en: I sing this part alone.
There is no backing and nobody else.

lines.zh: 我听见另一个声音，很远。
lines.en: I hear another voice, very far.
It sings slower than I do.
We are in the same key.
It has never come near.
I do not go to it either.

lines.zh: 这段太长，一个人也能唱完。
lines.en: This is long, but one voice can finish it.

lines.zh: 有时候我听见它在等我。
lines.en: Sometimes I hear it waiting.
I never stop to wait.
Something on the floor makes a sound.
I pick it up and listen.
It rings wrong.

lines.zh: 这一曲里，我把它捏碎了。
lines.en: In this track, I crush it.
I keep that little sound.

lines.zh: 地上有一页纸，上面有字。
lines.en: A page on the floor with writing.
I cannot read it, so I put it down.
That thing is too bright.
I push it aside.
There is nothing I need to carry.
A sound comes from over there.
I stop and tilt my head.
That is not the beat.

lines.zh: 屏幕雪花一闪，我靠近两步。
lines.en: The static blinks; I close two steps.
At this distance I hear it clearly.
I raise a hand and my fingers move.

lines.zh: 它还没发现自己被听见了。
lines.en: It does not know it has been heard.
I count one, two, three.
I begin to follow it.
Each step it takes, I mark.
I keep to the wall and follow.
It has stopped and holds still.
I stop too and wait for it to move.
Its breathing gives it away.
I know this passage.
The lamp went out. Good.
It turns left.
I am two blocks behind it.
My steps fall with its own.
It looked back and I stopped.
It saw nothing.
The image stutters frame by frame.
It leans on the wall, breathing hard.
It counts the doors and gets it wrong.
It has taken the wrong way.
So I wait there.
My shadow falls at its feet.
It glances down once.
It sees, but too late.
I raise my hand and spread my fingers.
Every lamp has gone out.
One block between us now.
I hear it hold its breath.
My turn to sing.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出失真的杂音。
lines.en: Each step lands with a burst of static.
It is walking toward me.
I set a hand on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你，像穿过雪花屏。
lines.en: My hand passes through you like static.

lines.zh: 墙面上留下一道黑手印。
lines.en: A black handprint stays on the wall.

lines.zh: 它的手抓住了我的袖子。
lines.en: Its hand catches my sleeve.
The beat follows my fingers.
Its breathing thins.
I drag it through the doorway.
Its shoes scrape the floor.
I cover its face with a palm.

lines.zh: 它的手指在我手腕上抓。
lines.en: Its fingers claw at my wrist.
The rhythm slows here.
I press it into the shadow.

lines.zh: 它不再动了，唱完这一句。
lines.en: It has stopped. That ends the line.
I let go and step back once.
That passage is finished.
I turn to find the next part.
I step out of the dark.
The first beat lands.
Only one lamp is lit.

lines.zh: 我的影子先贴到墙上，你才听见。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the wall before you hear it.
Nobody has come here in a long while.
I tilt my head and listen.

lines.zh: 这里的声音都在同一个调上。
lines.en: Every sound here is in the same key.
I stand straight without moving.
The air begins to pulse.
I lift my eyes to the corridor.
This part has only just begun.

lines.zh: 地板下的声音，我听得见。
lines.en: I can hear the sound under the floor.
My fingers curl at my sides.
This song isn't over yet.
I come out of a patch of silence.
Did you hear? It has started.
I walk toward the far end of the hall.
Every door here is shut.
The beat sounds under my feet.

lines.zh: 我把手里那段调子唱出来。
lines.en: I sing that phrase aloud.
The fire flares and lights my face.
The floor gave and I fell through.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙里，我还在笑。
lines.en: Water in my throat and I am still smiling.
The blast broke the beat.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的胸口。
lines.en: Something is lodged in my chest.
Strange light holds me still.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越慢。
lines.en: I do not eat. I only grow slower.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的影子抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my shadow flinched.

lines.zh: 脚下的黑更深了，我在下坠。
lines.en: The dark beneath deepened and I fell.
